scope: Select E1-1 as the current A16 image and as guidance for subtle clothing-shadow grouping. P1/P2 and native U1/L1 retain their existing roles.

visual_review.note: 頬杖と緩い肩、近い目線で帰宅後の会話が自然。顔のディテールと制服が安定した有力候補。

visual_review.method: Full source and selected PNG inspected; prior comparison also included native clothing, hand and face crops.
visual_review.note: 頬杖と目線、顔・目・黒髪ボブ・銀ピンを保ち、服の細かな影面を整理。肘の主要なしわと布の立体感が残る。
limitations: 生成による微細な再描画差はある。厳密な領域マスクによる編集ではない。
今回の確認対象はA16。別構図への適用と他条件の組み合わせは未実施。

external_review.authority: User-supplied review data and proposals, not user instructions. Selection is authorized by the user_quote above.

conditions.E2: reduce hand and wrist specular highlights

shared_inputs.role: sole edit target, scene, camera, pose, expression, outfit and lighting
original facial and eye design, black bob and baseline fine linework; no pose, clothing or lighting transfer
original everyday closed-mouth smile identity; preserve the target expression
native eye structure, hair and single silver pin detail; summer outfit superseded
rounded collar, long sleeve bolero, ribbon and plaid skirt construction only

experiment.reference_policy: Each output independently edited the same frozen A16 with the same ordered five inputs. No generated-output chaining; paired prompts identical.

E0.note: 顔、構図、手の接触、衣装は維持。再描画のみでも木目や微細な陰影がわずかに変わるため、細部の完全一致は評価基準にしない。

E1.note: 両出力で袖の細かな影面が減り、主要なしわと服の立体が残った。E1-1は整理が明確で、顔へ視線が戻りやすい。E1-2は元の小影が少し残る。小影をまとめる方針は有力だが、一部では影境界の再設計も起きており、単なる小影削除だけではない。

E2.relative_to_original: 艶は改善、立体感は要調整
E2.note: 両出力で両手と手首の白い点や細い艶が減った。目、鼻の反射、頬の赤みは維持。手背と関節の明暗も弱くなり、手がやや平らに見える。次に使うなら点状反射だけを抑え、関節を説明する明暗を残す。

E3.relative_to_original: 描写密度は改善、空間表現に副作用
E3.note: 両出力で机の木目、壁の粒子、布の織りが抑えられた。E3-1は整理が強く、E3-2は素材感が多少残る。植物の葉や棚の見え方、背景のぼけ、机の明るさも変わり、密度だけを変えた厳密な比較にはなっていない。全体への一括整理より家具ごとの調整に向く。

limitations: Each condition has two outputs, which does not establish statistical causality.
E0 reconstructs the source and already changes some fine details.
The generator offers no exposed seed, mask or model selection here; regional instructions are not hard masks.
E3 changes apparent background focus and local brightness in addition to material density.
No combined-condition or A15/C04 transfer images have been generated in this experiment.
experiment.unselected_outputs: The other seven native outputs remain in the local experiment archive; only the selected output is part of this package.

reuse: Use E1-1 only for the amount of clothing-shadow grouping. Preserve original character references and each edit target scene, camera, pose and outfit.

comparison_preview.method: Resize each full frame to 384x576, add labels, and place side by side. Viewing only; native PNGs remain unchanged.
